description: Use when the trial was started for the wrong website (action "move": the old site stops), or the tag must also work on a test or staging site (action "add": both work). Same agent_token, script tag, claim_url and free words; all sites share one limit. Not needed for localhost: use localhost_script_tag.

action.description: "move" (default): replace the site. "add": keep the site and also allow this test site (up to 3).

name: proxylang_change_site
title: Change or add the trial's site
